items.name: Cryptbloom
items.description: Life from Death: Whenever an enemy champion dies within 3s of being damaged by you, a nova spawns at their location, healing allied champions for 100 + 20% Ability Power Health (60s cooldown).

02975a7a-5eb6-41c9-8719-99789024c33a.name: Spellslinger's Shoes
02975a7a-5eb6-41c9-8719-99789024c33a.description: Big Bully: Basic attacks and active abilities deal 18 bonus true damage to minions.

123685c1-f458-46c7-bcda-a01c1366819b.name: Bloodletter's Curse
123685c1-f458-46c7-bcda-a01c1366819b.description: Vile Decay: When abilities or passives deal magic damage to champions, their Magic Resistance is reduced by 7.5% for 6s (stacks up to 30%).

2e3e6027-0702-4245-9dbd-b81a5f5a9d07.name: Whispering Circlet
2e3e6027-0702-4245-9dbd-b81a5f5a9d07.description:
Harmony: Gain 0.5% bonus Heal and Shield Power equal to max Mana and refund 25% of Mana spent.
Mana Charge: Spending Mana grants 14 max Mana, up to 700. Can trigger up to 2 times every 10s. At max stacks, automatically upgrades into Diadem of Songs.

3af5f23b-a5e8-4daf-a1e0-d56788a2e986.name: Dusk and Dawn
3af5f23b-a5e8-4daf-a1e0-d56788a2e986.description: Spellblade: After casting an ability, your next attack deals bonus magic damage equal to 75% base Attack Damage + 10% Ability Power and heals you for 10% Ability Power + 3% bonus Health. Shortly after, it applies an additional on-hit effect to the target (1.5s cooldown). Deals reduced damage to structures.

497996e0-5a4e-42bb-8395-a8945ca7484b.name: Mercurial Scimitar
497996e0-5a4e-42bb-8395-a8945ca7484b.description: Quicksilver: Removes all crowd control effects from your champion and grants crowd control immunity for 0.25s. Afterwards, gain 30% Tenacity and 30% Slow Resistance for 1.5s (60s cooldown).

4e5aa7ec-5caf-4255-af5d-127f49fcaffe.name: Mikael's Blessing
4e5aa7ec-5caf-4255-af5d-127f49fcaffe.description: Purify: Removes all crowd control effects from the target champion and grants crowd control immunity (except suppression and airborne) for 0.2s. Also heals the target for 150-250 Health (75s cooldown).

5e258e25-76b0-4dfc-8669-ff5dfbc57e4f.name: Armorbreaker Boots
5e258e25-76b0-4dfc-8669-ff5dfbc57e4f.description: Cloudwalker: Gain 20 Movement Speed while out of combat.

68f6f056-2ea8-4c50-8d44-a0f14e520ea6.name: Fiendhunter Bolts
68f6f056-2ea8-4c50-8d44-a0f14e520ea6.description:
Night Watch: Gain 20 Ultimate Ability Haste.
Opening Barrage: After casting your ultimate, your next 3 attacks gain 50% Attack Speed and always critically strike, dealing 80% of your normal Critical Strike damage, for 8s. If an attack would already critically strike, it instead deals 15% bonus true damage (45s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e030.name: Manamune
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e030.description:
Awe: Grants Attack Damage equal to 2% of max Mana and refunds 15% of all Mana spent.
Mana Charge: Increases max Mana by 14 each time you spend Mana or attack, up to 700 bonus Mana, transforming Manamune into Muramana. Triggers up to 3 times every 10s. You can only hold one Tear of the Goddess item at a time.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e031.name: Magnetic Blaster
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e031.description:
Overdrive: Gain 5% Movement Speed.
Power Frenzy: Moving and attacking build up Energized attacks. Energized attacks gain 100 range (50 range for melee attacks), deal 40-100 bonus magic damage and grant 60 Movement Speed for 0.75s. This damage bounces to up to 5 nearby enemies and can critically strike (deals 50%-80% bonus damage against minions).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e032.name: Kircheis Shard
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e032.description: Discharge: Energized attacks deal 40 bonus magic damage. Moving and attacking builds up Energized attacks.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e033.name: Recurve Bow
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e033.description: Steeled: Attacks deal 15 bonus physical damage on hit against champions.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e034.name: Youmuu's Ghostblade
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e034.description:
Cut: +15 Armor Penetration.
Haunt: 3s after leaving combat with enemy champions, gain 30 bonus Movement Speed (20 for ranged champions).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e036.name: Infinity Edge
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e036.description: Infinity: Critical strikes deal 230% damage instead of 200%.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e037.name: Muramana
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e037.description:
Awe: Grants Attack Damage equal to 2% of max Mana and refunds 15% of all Mana spent.
Shock: When an attack hits an enemy champion, drains 1.5% of current Mana and deals bonus physical damage equal to 3.5% (melee) / 3% (ranged) of max Mana.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e038.name: Divine Sunderer
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e038.description: Spellblade: After using an ability, your next attack within 10s deals 10% of the target's max Health as bonus physical damage (7% for ranged attacks). If the target is a champion, heal for 6% of the target's max Health (2.5% for ranged attacks) (1.5s cooldown). Damage is reduced against structures.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e03a.name: Sterak's Gage
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e03a.description:
Stern: +50% base Attack Damage as bonus physical damage.
Lifeline: Taking damage that would drop you below 35% Health grants a shield equal to 75% of your bonus Health that decays over 5s (75s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e03c.name: Wit's End
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e03c.description: Wit's End: Basic attacks deal 40 bonus magic damage on hit.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e03d.name: Eclipse
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e03d.description: Ever Rising Moon: Hitting an enemy champion with 2 different attacks or abilities within 1.8s deals bonus physical damage equal to 7% of the target's max Health (3.5% for ranged champions). It also grants you a shield that absorbs damage equal to 140 + 35% bonus Attack Damage (70 + 18% bonus Attack Damage for ranged champions) for 2s (6s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e03e.name: Nashor's Claw
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e03e.description: Magic Needle: Gain 15 Attack Damage or 30 Ability Power (adaptive).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e03f.name: Runaan's Hurricane
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e03f.description: Wind's Fury: Attacks hit 2 additional nearby enemies, each dealing 55% physical damage. These attacks can critically strike and apply on-hit effects.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e040.name: Serpent's Fang
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e040.description:
Gouge: +15 Armor Penetration.
Shield Reaver: Damaging an enemy champion reduces any shields they gain for 3s. Melee champions apply (10% bonus Attack Damage + 40)% shield reduction, capped at 60%; ranged champions apply (10% bonus Attack Damage + 25)% shield reduction, capped at 45%. When you damage an enemy not affected by Shield Reaver, all of their shields are reduced by the same amount.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e041.name: Death's Dance
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e041.description:
Defy: If a champion you damaged within the last 3s dies, the remaining Ignore Pain damage is cleansed and you heal over 2s for 90% of bonus Attack Damage.
Cauterize: Stores 30% of physical and magic damage taken (12% for ranged champions) and takes the stored amount as true damage over 3s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e042.name: Bloodthirster
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e042.description: Converts overhealing from your Life Steal into a shield, up to 165-345 (based on level).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e043.name: Blade of The Ruined King
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e043.description:
Ruined Strikes: Attacks deal bonus physical damage on hit equal to 7% of the enemy's current Health (10% for melee attacks). Minimum damage: 15. Max damage against monsters: 60.
Siphon: Hitting the same enemy champion 3 times with basic attacks or abilities slows them by 30% for 1.5s (30s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e044.name: Mortal Reminder
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e044.description:
Last Whisper: Gain 30% Armor Penetration. Attacks that critically strike gain 6% bonus Armor Penetration.
Sepsis: Dealing physical damage applies 50% Grievous Wounds to enemy champions for 3s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e045.name: Tear of the Goddess
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e045.description:
Awe: Refunds 10% of Mana spent.
Mana Charge: Increases max Mana by 6 each time you spend Mana, up to 700 bonus Mana. Triggers up to 3 times every 10s. You can only hold one Tear of the Goddess item at a time.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e047.name: Essence Reaver
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e047.description:
Spellblade: After casting an ability, your next basic attack within 10s deals bonus physical damage equal to 135% base Attack Damage + 0-80 (based on Crit Rate) and restores Mana equal to 50% of the damage dealt (1.5s cooldown).
Mana Siphon: Attacks restore 3% of your missing Mana on hit.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e048.name: Chempunk Chainsword
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e048.description: Hackshorn: Dealing physical damage to enemy champions applies 50% Grievous Wounds for 3s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e049.name: Hullbreaker
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e049.description:
Full Sail: Gain 5% Movement Speed.
Captain: Every 4th attack against champions and epic monsters deals bonus physical damage equal to 160% base Attack Damage + 5% max Health (ranged champions deal 40% of the damage), increased to 240% base Attack Damage + 9% max Health against structures (ranged champions deal 40% of the damage).
Boarding Party: Nearby allied siege minions and super minions gain 20-130 Armor (25% more for ranged champions) and 10-120 Magic Resistance (25% more for ranged champions).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04a.name: Spear of Shojin
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04a.description:
Dragonforce: Gain 20 Basic Ability Haste.
Focused Will: Damaging enemies or monsters with abilities increases your champion's ability and passive damage by 3% for 6s (stacks up to 4 times). Focused Will can only stack once per second per ability cast.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04b.name: Terminus
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04b.description:
Shadow: Attacks deal 30 bonus magic damage on hit.
Juxtaposition: Attacks alternate between Light and Dark on-hit effects. Light attacks grant 5-8 Armor and Magic Resistance for 5s on hit. Dark attacks grant 10% Armor Penetration and 10% Magic Penetration for 5s on hit. Each on-hit effect stacks up to 3 times. While you hold this item, the bonus Armor Penetration and Magic Penetration it grants are capped at 40%.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04c.name: Titanic Hydra
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04c.description: Cleave: Every 1.75s, your next attack deals bonus physical damage equal to 25 + 3% of your bonus max Health (also applies to turrets) and creates a shockwave that deals physical damage equal to 80 + 10% of your bonus max Health to enemies behind the target. Ranged champions deal 75% of the damage.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04d.name: Sheen
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04d.description: Spellblade: Using an ability causes your next attack within 10s to deal bonus physical damage equal to 100% base Attack Damage (1.5s cooldown). Damage is reduced against structures.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04e.name: Trinity Force
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04e.description:
Zeal: +5% Movement Speed.
Spellblade: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10s deals bonus physical damage equal to 200% base Attack Damage (1.5s cooldown). Damage is reduced against structures.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04f.name: Serylda's Grudge
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e04f.description:
Last Whisper: Gain 30% Armor Penetration.
Icy: Damaging active abilities and empowered attacks slow the Movement Speed of enemies below 60% of their current Health by 30% for 1s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e050.name: The Black Cleaver
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e050.description:
Carve: Dealing physical damage to a champion reduces their Armor by 6% for 6s, stacking up to 5 times for a 30% reduction.
Pursuit: Gain 20 Movement Speed when dealing physical damage. Gain 40 Movement Speed when moving toward enemy champions with 5 stacks of Carve. Ranged champions gain half of these bonuses.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e051.name: Soul Transfer
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e051.description: Shadow Dance: Critically striking an enemy champion or epic monster summons a clone that lasts 4s and attacks nearby enemies. The clone gains 20% of your Attack Damage and also gains 30% of your Crit Rate as Attack Speed. Up to 2 clones can exist at the same time. If a clone moves more than 600 units away from you, it disappears early.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e052.name: Duskblade of Draktharr
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e052.description:
Razor: +18 Armor Penetration.
Nightstalker: Your first attack against a champion deals 60-160 bonus physical damage and slows them by 99% for 0.35s (10s cooldown).
Champion takedowns reset the cooldown.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e053.name: Navori Flickerblades
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e053.description: Transcendent Strikes: Attacks reduce the remaining cooldown of your basic abilities by 15%.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e054.name: The Collector
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e054.description:
Assassin: +10 Armor Penetration.
Death and Taxes: Dealing damage that would leave an enemy champion below (4% + 2% Crit Rate) of their max Health executes them, permanently increases the max Health execute threshold by 0.1% and grants 25 bonus gold.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e055.name: Edge of Night
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e055.description:
Bury: +8 Armor Penetration.
Annul: Grants a magic shield that blocks the next enemy ability (35s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e056.name: Maw of Malmortius
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e056.description: Lifeline: When you take magic damage that would leave you below 35% Health, gain 10% Omnivamp until the end of combat and a shield that absorbs 220-530 magic damage for 3s (75s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e057.name: Phantom Dancer
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e057.description:
Light Feet: +7% Movement Speed.
Spectral Waltz: Hitting an enemy with an attack grants 6% Attack Speed and 1% Movement Speed for 6s, stacking up to 5 times.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e058.name: Sundered Sky
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e058.description: Lightshield Strike: Your first attack against an enemy champion critically strikes (6s cooldown per target), dealing 160% damage and restoring Health equal to 125% base Attack Damage + 6% of your missing Health.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e05a.name: Plated Steelcaps
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e05a.description: Block: Basic attacks from champions deal 10% reduced damage to you.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e05b.name: Crown of the Shattered Queen
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e05b.description:
Safeguard: Grants a magic shield that blocks the next enemy ability. When the shield breaks, damage taken is reduced by 40% for 1s (40s cooldown).
Poise: Ability Power is increased by 20 while Safeguard is active. Dealing magic damage to enemy champions with an active ability reduces Safeguard's cooldown by 4s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e05c.name: Horizon Focus
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e05c.description:
Hypershot: Damaging an enemy champion with an ability from 600 units away reveals them for 8s and increases damage dealt to them by 10%.
Focus: Triggering Hypershot reveals all enemy champions within 1200 units of the target for 3s (12s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e063.name: Liandry's Torment
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e063.description:
Torment: Damaging abilities and empowered attacks deal 2% of the target's max Health as magic damage per second for 3s.

Madness: While fighting enemy champions, deal 2% bonus damage per second (up to 6%).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e064.name: Bandle Fantasy
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e064.description: Fire Flower: Damaging an enemy champion with an active ability spawns a trap at their feet. After a short delay, the trap deals 105 + 15% Ability Power magic damage to enemies inside it (8s cooldown per target). If a target is hit by more than one trap placed by the same champion within a short period, traps after the first deal only 20% damage.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e065.name: Knight's Vow
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e065.description:
Sacrifice: While your Worthy ally is nearby, 12% of the damage they take is redirected to you. You also heal for 10% of the damage your Worthy ally deals to champions.
Pledge: When you buy or rebuy this item, designate an ally as Worthy.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e066.name: Kraken Slayer
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e066.description:
Cloud Step: Gain 5% Movement Speed.
Bring It Down: Every third attack deals 150-210 bonus physical damage (120-168 for ranged champions), increased by 0.75% for every 1% of the target's missing Health. The bonus physical damage is capped at 75%.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e068.name: Executioner's Calling
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e068.description: Rend: Dealing physical damage to enemy champions applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 3s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e06c.name: Riftmaker
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e06c.description:
Void Corruption: While fighting enemy champions, deal 2% bonus damage per second (up to 8%). At full strength, gain 10% (melee) / 6% (ranged) Omnivamp.

Void Infusion: Gain Ability Power equal to 2% of your bonus Health.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e06d.name: Hextech Alternator
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e06d.description: Revved: Damaging abilities and empowered attacks against champions deal 25-60 bonus magic damage (20s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e06e.name: Thornmail
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e06e.description:
Thorns: When hit by an attack, deal 20 + 6% bonus Armor + 1% bonus Health magic damage to the attacker.
Entangle: When hit by an attack from an enemy champion or when you damage one, apply 50% Grievous Wounds to them for 3s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e06f.name: Overlord's Bloodmail
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e06f.description:
Tyranny: Gain Attack Damage equal to 2.5% of your bonus Health.
Retribution: Gain up to 9% increased Attack Damage based on your missing Health.
You gain the maximum Retribution bonus while below 30% Health.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e070.name: Relic Shield
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e070.description:
Tribute: Every 30s, gain 1 energy orb that orbits you (max 3 orbs). While near an ally, the following actions trigger Tribute, consuming 1 energy orb to grant you 65 gold and restore 20-80 Health:
1. Damaging enemy champions or structures with abilities or attacks.
2. Attacking minions below 65% Health. This also executes them, and the gold from those minion kills goes to the nearest ally.
3. Having 3 orbs and being near a minion when it dies.
Triggering Tribute grants Tribute stacks to the nearest ally.
Warden: Deal 1 bonus damage to Vision Wards revealed by Oracle Lens, Control Wards and Scryer's Bloom.
Restriction: You don't receive gold from killing minions, but gain gold equal to 50% of the bounty. The gold from your minion kills goes to the nearest ally. Gold gained from killing monsters is also reduced by 50%.
Quest: Earn 750 gold with this item to transform it into Black Mist Scythe. This bonds you with the ally who has the most Tribute stacks and makes you best partners.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e071.name: Mana Boots
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e071.description:
Magic Break: +8 Magic Penetration.
Balance: Manaless champions gain 75% bonus Health Regen.
Big Bully: Attacks and active abilities deal 18 bonus physical damage to minions.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e074.name: Staff of Flowing Water
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e074.description: Rapids: Healing or shielding an ally grants both of you 15 Ability Haste and 40 Ability Power (based on the target's level) for 6s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e075.name: Imperial Mandate
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e075.description:
Control: Crowd control abilities gain 20 Ability Haste.

Command: Applying crowd control to an enemy champion marks them for 4s, causing them to take 7% bonus damage for the duration.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e076.name: Black Mist Scythe
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e076.description:
Versatile: Gain 14 Attack Damage or 28 Ability Power (adaptive).
Soul Summoning: Every 60s, gain 75 gold, 25 Health and 2 Attack Damage or 4 Ability Power (adaptive), up to a maximum of 250 Health and 20 Attack Damage or 40 Ability Power (adaptive). Deal 2 bonus damage to Vision Wards revealed by Oracle Lens, Control Wards and Scryer's Bloom.
Gain 10% Movement Speed while moving toward your perfect partner out of combat. If you are more than 2500 units apart, this bonus increases to 30%.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e078.name: Berserker's Greaves
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e078.description: Blessed Blade: Attacks restore 10 Health on hit.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07a.name: Morellonomicon
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07a.description: Affliction: Dealing magic damage to enemy champions applies 50% Grievous Wounds for 3s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07b.name: Mejai's Soulstealer
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07b.description:
Glory: Gain up to 30 Glory stacks from champion takedowns. Melee champions gain 3 stacks per kill and 2 stacks per assist; ranged champions gain 4 stacks per kill and 2 stacks per assist. Lose 10 stacks on death.
Dread: Gain 5 Ability Power per Glory stack. At 10 or more Glory stacks, gain 10% bonus Movement Speed.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07c.name: Haunting Guise
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07c.description: Madness: While fighting enemy champions, deal 2% bonus damage per second (up to 6%).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07d.name: Sapphire Crystal
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07d.description: Mana Charge: Increases max Mana by 5 each time you spend Mana, up to 250 bonus Mana. Triggers up to 3 times every 12s. You can only hold one Tear of the Goddess item at a time.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07e.name: Unending Despair
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07e.description: Anguish: Every 4s while in combat with a champion, deal 3% of your max Health as magic damage to nearby enemy champions and heal for 250% of the damage dealt. Ability Haste from items doesn't affect Anguish.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07f.name: Hollow Radiance
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e07f.description:
Immolate: While in combat, deal 20-30 + 1% of your bonus Health magic damage per second to nearby enemies for 5s. Deals 125% damage to monsters and 200% damage to minions.
Desolate: Killing a neutral monster or an enemy deals 30 + 2% of your bonus Health magic damage in the surrounding area.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e080.name: Nashor's Tooth
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e080.description: Gnaw: Basic attacks deal 15 + 20% Ability Power bonus magic damage on hit.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e081.name: Guardian Angel
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e081.description: Rebirth: Upon taking lethal damage, restores 50% base Health and 100% max Mana after 4s of stasis (180s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e082.name: Spectral Sickle
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e082.description:
Versatile: Gain 10 Attack Damage or 20 Ability Power (adaptive).
Tribute: Every 30s, gain 1 energy orb that orbits you (max 3 orbs). While near an ally, the following actions trigger Tribute, consuming 1 energy orb to grant you 65 gold and restore 20-80 Health:
1. Damaging enemy champions or structures with abilities or attacks.
2. Attacking minions below 65% Health. This also executes them, and the gold from those minion kills goes to the nearest ally.
3. Having 3 orbs and being near a minion when it dies.
Triggering Tribute grants Tribute stacks to the nearest ally.
Warden: Deal 1 bonus damage to Vision Wards revealed by Oracle Lens, Control Wards and Scryer's Bloom.
Restriction: You don't receive gold from killing minions, but gain gold equal to 50% of the bounty. The gold from your minion kills goes to the nearest ally. Gold gained from killing monsters is also reduced by 50%.
Quest: Earn 750 gold with this item to transform it into Black Mist Scythe. This bonds you with the ally who has the most Tribute stacks and makes you best partners.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e083.name: Rod of Ages
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e083.description:
Eternity: Restores Mana equal to 15% of damage taken from champions. Spending Mana restores Health equal to 20% of the Mana cost, up to 25 Health per cast.
Veteran: Each stack grants 15 Health, 30 Mana and 4 Ability Power. Gains 1 stack every 35s, up to 10 stacks, for a total of 150 Health, 300 Mana and 40 Ability Power.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e084.name: Seraph's Embrace
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e084.description:
Awe: Grants Ability Power equal to 2% of max Mana and refunds 25% of all Mana spent.
Lifeline: Taking damage that would drop you below 35% Health consumes 20% of your current Mana to grant a shield equal to that amount + 100 for 2s (70s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e086.name: Catalyst of Aeons
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e086.description: Eternity: Restores Mana equal to 15% of damage taken from champions. Restores Health equal to 20% of Mana spent, up to 15 Health per cast.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e087.name: Redemption
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e087.description: Intervention: Target a large area. After 2.5s, restore 150-350 Health (based on the ally's level) to allied units and deal 10% max Health true damage to enemy champions (60s cooldown). Can be cast while dead.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e088.name: Experimental Hexplate
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e088.description:
Hex Charge: Gain 20 Ultimate Ability Haste.

Overdrive: After casting your ultimate, gain 40% Attack Speed (20% for ranged champions) and 20% Movement Speed (10% for ranged champions) for 8s (30s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e089.name: Ionian Boots of Lucidity
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e089.description: Summoned: Reduces summoner spell cooldowns by 15%.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e08e.name: Sunfire Aegis
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e08e.description: Immolate: While in combat, deals 20 + 1.5% bonus Health magic damage to nearby enemies every second. Immolate deals 175%-250% damage to minions and 130% damage to monsters.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e08f.name: Guinsoo's Rageblade
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e08f.description:
Wrath: Attacks deal 30 bonus magic damage.
Seething Strike: Basic attacks grant 8% Attack Speed, stacking up to 4 times. At max stacks, every third basic attack triggers an additional on-hit effect.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e091.name: Phage
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e091.description: Rage: Each basic attack that hits a unit grants 20 Movement Speed for 2s. This bonus Movement Speed doesn't stack, and the effect is halved for ranged champions.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e093.name: Lich Bane
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e093.description:
Bane: +5% Movement Speed.
Spellblade: Using an ability causes your next attack within 10s to deal bonus magic damage equal to 75% base Attack Damage + 45% Ability Power (1.5s cooldown). Damage is reduced against structures.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e094.name: Archangel's Staff
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e094.description:
Awe: Grants Ability Power equal to 1% of max Mana and refunds 25% of all Mana spent.
Mana Charge: Increases max Mana by 14 each time Mana is spent, up to 700 bonus Mana, transforming Archangel's Staff into Seraph's Embrace. Triggers up to 3 times every 10s. Limited to one Tear of the Goddess item.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e096.name: Bulwark of the Mountain
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e096.description: Every 60s, grants 75 gold and 1 stack of Soul Force (max 10 stacks). Each Soul Force stack grants 25 Health and 2 Attack Damage or 4 Ability Power (adaptive).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e097.name: Rylai's Crystal Scepter
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e097.description: Icy: Damaging active abilities and empowered attacks slow enemies by 30% for 0.75s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e098.name: Malignance
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e098.description:
Scorn: Your ultimate gains 20 Ability Haste.
Toxic Field: Damaging a champion with your ultimate burns the ground beneath them for 3s, dealing 60 + 5% Ability Power magic damage per second and reducing their Magic Resistance by 10. The burn radius grows with damage dealt, reaching its maximum at 800 damage.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e099.name: Lost Chapter
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e099.description: Enlighten: On level up, restores 20% of max Mana over 3s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09a.name: Oblivion Orb
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09a.description: Grievous Wounds: Dealing magic damage to enemy champions applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 3s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09b.name: Gluttonous Greaves
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09b.description:
Balance of Power: Gain 12 Attack Damage or 20 Ability Power.

Conversion: Gain 5% Omnivamp + 0.5% Omnivamp per takedown participation (up to 5% bonus, for a maximum of 10% Omnivamp).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09c.name: Luden's Echo
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09c.description: Echo: Your next damaging ability or empowered basic attack deals 75 + 8% Ability Power magic damage to the primary target and up to 5 other nearby enemies. For each target Echo hits, the primary target takes 20 + 1.2% Ability Power bonus magic damage (9s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09d.name: Infinity Orb
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09d.description:
Destiny: +5% Movement Speed.
Balance: +15 Magic Penetration.
Inevitable Demise: Abilities and empowered attacks critically strike for 20% bonus damage against enemies below 40% Health.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09e.name: Cosmic Drive
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09e.description: Spelldance: Dealing magic or true damage to champions grants 30 Movement Speed for 4s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09f.name: Oceanid's Trident
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e09f.description: Lethal Weapon: Damaging an enemy champion with abilities reduces any shields they gain for 3s. Area-of-effect abilities apply (5% Ability Power + 25)% shield reduction, capped at 45%; single-target abilities apply (5% Ability Power + 40)% shield reduction, capped at 60%. When you damage an enemy not affected by Lethal Weapon, all of their shields are reduced by the same amount.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a0.name: Psychic Projector
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a0.description:
Conversion: Gain Ability Power equal to 3.5% of bonus Health.
Projection: While you have at least 950 bonus Health, gain 20% of your Ability Power as Armor and 10% of your Ability Power as Magic Resistance (bonuses cap at 400 Ability Power).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a1.name: Awakened Soulstealer
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a1.description:
Soul Hunt: +15 Magic Penetration.
Wandering Soul: Whenever you take down an enemy champion within 3s of damaging them, your ability cooldowns are reduced by 25%. You steal 10% of their base Movement Speed for 10s and 50% of their Ability Haste until they respawn. Ability Haste stolen this way stacks.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a2.name: Abyssal Mask
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a2.description: Unmake: All enemy champions within 650 units take 12% more magic damage.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a3.name: Randuin's Omen
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a3.description:
Countercurrent: When struck by a physical critical strike, gain 1 stack of Countercurrent. Each stack grants 5% Movement Speed and 5% Slow Resistance. Max 4 stacks.
Resilience: Critical strikes deal 30% less physical damage to you.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a4.name: Radiant Spark
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a4.description: Immolate: Deals 5-10 magic damage per second to nearby enemies.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a5.name: Dead Man's Plate
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a5.description:
Relentless: +4% Movement Speed.
Momentum: Moving builds Momentum, granting up to 40 Movement Speed at 100 stacks. Attacking removes all Momentum stacks. Stacks decay when your movement is impaired.
Crushing Blow: Attacks deal up to 100 bonus magic damage based on Momentum built. Melee attacks that consume maximum Momentum also slow by 75% for 1s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a6.name: Force of Nature
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a6.description:
Storm: +5% Movement Speed.
Absorb: Taking magic damage from enemy champions grants a stack of Steadfast for 7s, up to 4 stacks. Damaging enemy champions refreshes the duration. At max stacks, gain 6% Movement Speed and 70 bonus Magic Resistance.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a7.name: Dawnshroud
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a7.description: Dawnbringer: When you immobilize a champion or are immobilized within 400 units of an enemy champion, gain 20% Armor and Magic Resistance, reveal nearby enemy champions for 3s and deal 40 + 2.5% bonus Health magic damage to them (3s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a8.name: Mantle of the Twelfth Hour
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0a8.description: Lifeline: When dropping below 30% max Health, instantly gain 200-300 bonus Health for 5s and heal over 5s for 200-400 + 120% bonus Armor + 120% bonus Magic Resistance + 15% bonus Health. During this time, you grow in size by 10% and gain 10% Movement Speed and 20% bonus Tenacity.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0aa.name: Warden's Mail
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0aa.description: Cold Steel: When hit by an attack, reduces the attacker's Attack Speed by 15% for 1.5s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0ab.name: Warmog's Armor
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0ab.description:
Warmog's Heart: If you have at least 1250 bonus Health, restore 3.5% max Health per second if you haven't taken damage in the last 5s.
Blessed: Increases all healing and shielding on yourself by 30%.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0ac.name: Frozen Heart
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0ac.description: Winter's Caress: All enemy champions within 650 units lose 25% Attack Speed.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0ad.name: Heartsteel
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0ad.description: Colossal Consumption: While within 700 units of an enemy champion, charge up over 2.5s to land a powerful strike. This charged attack deals bonus physical damage equal to 140 + 3.5% max Health and grants max Health equal to 15% of the damage dealt. 20s cooldown per target.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0ae.name: Radiant Virtue
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0ae.description: Guiding Light: Casting your ultimate makes you Transcend, increasing your max Health by 10% for 6s. While Transcended, you and allied champions within 1200 units heal for 2.5% of your max Health per second for the duration (60s cooldown). If you are a ranged champion, heals you grant are reduced by 50%.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0af.name: Iceborn Gauntlet
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0af.description: Spellblade: Using an ability causes your next attack within 10s to deal bonus physical damage equal to 100% base Attack Damage + 25% bonus Armor in an area and create a frost field for 2s that slows enemies by 30%. Armor increases the size of the frost field (1.5s cooldown). Damage is reduced against structures.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b0.name: Winter's Approach
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b0.description:
Awe: Grants bonus Health equal to 15% of max Mana and refunds 15% of all Mana spent.
Mana Charge: Basic attacks, spending Mana and taking damage from champions, structures and epic monsters grant 14 max Mana. Grants up to 700 max Mana and can trigger at most 3 times every 10s. Limited to one Tear of the Goddess item.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b1.name: Fimbulwinter
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b1.description:
Awe: Grants bonus Health equal to 15% of max Mana and refunds 15% of all Mana spent.
Frozen Colossus: Whenever you impair an enemy champion's movement, gain a shield for 3s that absorbs 120 + 4.5% max Mana. If more than one enemy champion is nearby, the shield is increased by 80% (8s cooldown). This shield is 50% effective for ranged champions.
Only triggers while above 20% max Mana (8s cooldown).

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b2.name: Lord Dominik's Regards
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b2.description: Giant Slayer: Deal bonus damage based on the enemy champion's bonus Health. The bonus damage caps at 12%, reached when attacking an enemy champion with 1200 bonus Health.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b3.name: Ardent Censer
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b3.description: Censer: When you heal or shield an allied champion (other than yourself), that champion gains 30% Attack Speed and their attacks deal 25 bonus magic damage for 6s. This damage can critically strike.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b4.name: Spectre's Cowl
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b4.description: Spectral Visit: Grants 150% Health Regen for 10s after taking damage from an enemy champion.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b6.name: Emerging Scales
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b6.description: Discharge: Gain 20% Slow Resistance while in combat with an enemy champion.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b7.name: Harmonic Echo
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b7.description: Harmonic Echo: When you heal or shield an allied champion, the effect links to the nearest allied champion in range with the lowest Health percentage (excluding you), granting them 30% of that heal or 35% of that shield. If no other allied champion is in range, the original target receives that same additional heal or shield instead.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b8.name: Searing Crown
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b8.description: Touch of Fire: After dealing damage with an attack or ability, burns the target for 3s, dealing 1.4% of the target's max Health as magic damage per second (reduced to 0.7% for ranged users). Deals 150% damage to minions and monsters. Max 125 damage against monsters.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b9.name: Kaenic Rookern
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0b9.description: Magebane: If you take no magic damage for 12s, gain a magic shield that absorbs 50-150 + 14% max Health damage.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0ba.name: Bramble Vest
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0ba.description:
Thorns: When hit by an attack from an enemy champion, deals 4 + 6% bonus Armor magic damage to the attacker.
Entangle: When hit by an attack from an enemy champion or when you damage one, apply 40% Grievous Wounds to them for 3s.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0bc.name: Amaranth's Twinguard
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0bc.description: Endurance: While in combat with enemy champions, gain 1 Endurance stack every second, up to 5. At max stacks, you grow in size by 20% and gain 20% Tenacity, 30% bonus Armor and 30% bonus Magic Resistance until you leave combat.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0bd.name: Yordle Trap
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0bd.description: Trapper: Slowing or immobilizing an enemy champion empowers you for 8s (4s for ranged champions) and grants 20 Movement Speed. For the duration, you and nearby allies gain 30% bonus Attack Speed (20% for ranged champions). If you or an ally score a kill while inspired, you gain 20 gold.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0bf.name: Zeke's Convergence
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0bf.description:
Convergence: Gain 10 Ultimate Ability Haste.

Frostfire Tempest: Casting your ultimate deals 150 magic damage and slows nearby enemies by 30% for 5s. If no enemy champion is in range when you cast your ultimate, the effect is delayed for up to 5s or until an enemy champion enters range.

6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0c2.name: Bami's Cinder
6a04bc1334f787bb5bb2e0c2.description: Embers: Deal 10-20 magic damage per second to nearby enemies (deals 115% damage to minions and monsters).

6a0a641493de40f0abdf74a2.name: Zhonya's Hourglass
6a0a641493de40f0abdf74a2.description: Stasis: Become invulnerable and untargetable for 2.5s, but you cannot move, attack, cast abilities or use items during this time (120s cooldown).

6a1cebcd3454830b3e2b44c1.name: Glorious
6a1cebcd3454830b3e2b44c1.description: Glorious: Gain 30% Movement Speed. After 4s or when near an enemy champion, emit a shockwave that slows champions hit by 60% for 2s. You also gain 20% Tenacity and 20% Slow Resistance for 4s (45s cooldown).

6a1cec679f4b6d4b3e644715.name: Stridebreaker
6a1cec679f4b6d4b3e644715.description:
Breaking Shockwave: Dash a short distance forward and deal physical damage equal to 100% of your Attack Damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit are slowed by 40% for 3s (25s cooldown).

Stride: Dealing physical damage grants 20 Movement Speed for 2s.

6a1ced16e5e2ea7c46739296.name: Goredrinker
6a1ced16e5e2ea7c46739296.description: Thirsting Slash: Deals physical damage equal to 175% of your Attack Damage to nearby enemies. For each enemy champion hit, restore Health equal to 20% Attack Damage + 10% missing Health (12s cooldown).

6a1cee51ff5f404fb9352f46.name: Gargoyle Stoneplate
6a1cee51ff5f404fb9352f46.description: Gain a shield equal to 100 + 90% bonus Health that rapidly decays over 2.5s (60s cooldown).

6a1cef5635e22b3448e504c3.name: Hextech Rocketbelt
6a1cef5635e22b3448e504c3.description:
Protobelt: Dash toward the target direction and fire 7 magic bolts that deal 100 + 10% Ability Power magic damage to enemies hit (30s cooldown).

If a champion or monster is hit by more than one bolt, each additional bolt deals only 10% damage.

6a1cf06aa1ca3779fa800060.name: Quicksilver Sash
6a1cf06aa1ca3779fa800060.description: Quicksilver: Removes all crowd control effects from your champion and grants crowd control immunity for 0.25s. Afterwards, gain 30% Tenacity and 30% Slow Resistance for 1.5s (60s cooldown).

6a1cf11f44083aeb3854a21c.name: Galeforce
6a1cf11f44083aeb3854a21c.description: Cloudburst: Dash in the target direction and fire 3 missiles at the lowest-Health enemy near your destination, dealing 40-125 (based on level) + 35% bonus Attack Damage physical damage (60s cooldown).

6a1cf18456e576c5f5343978.name: Veil
6a1cf18456e576c5f5343978.description: Veil: Grants a nearby ally a spell shield for 3s that blocks the next hostile ability (60s cooldown).

6a1cf21fc4bfa81cbdf50d09.name: Locket of the Iron Solari
6a1cf21fc4bfa81cbdf50d09.description:
Locket: Grants a shield to you and nearby allies that absorbs 250-370 damage for 2.5s (60s cooldown).

If the target received this effect within the last 20s, the shield value is halved.

6a1cf2d8479e8bbb7e065c76.name: Dream Maker
6a1cf2d8479e8bbb7e065c76.description: Dream Maker: Gain two Dream Bubbles every 6s. When you heal or shield an ally with an active effect, both Dream Bubbles burst on them and empower them for 3s. The two bubbles grant the target 15%-30% bonus Movement Speed for 3s and make their next hit deal 15-90 bonus magic damage.

6c583d9a-97d1-4393-b6d1-7edc900965bd.name: Armored Advance
6c583d9a-97d1-4393-b6d1-7edc900965bd.description:
Block: Basic attacks from champions deal 10% reduced damage to you.

Noxian Endurance: Taking physical damage from champions grants a 20-140 (based on level) + 5% of your max Health physical shield (12s cooldown).

6fe1445d-5159-4fab-8368-2aac6effdccf.name: Stormrazor
6fe1445d-5159-4fab-8368-2aac6effdccf.description:
Energized: Moving and attacking build up an Energized attack.
Bolt: Your Energized attack deals 120 bonus magic damage and grants 45% Movement Speed for 1.5s.

79eaa54e-10e9-4aa4-aeec-fe3e78c6df0b.name: Verdant Barrier
79eaa54e-10e9-4aa4-aeec-fe3e78c6df0b.description: Annul: Grants a spell shield that blocks the next enemy ability (65s cooldown).

7d70c694-3912-48ae-9b98-67a41b12f7fa.name: Rapid Firecannon
7d70c694-3912-48ae-9b98-67a41b12f7fa.description:
Energized: Moving and attacking build up an Energized attack.
Sharpshooter: Your Energized attack deals 80 bonus magic damage and gains 35% bonus attack range, up to a maximum of 150.

858b7893-3259-4c97-b41b-80c07937ec52.name: Stormsurge
858b7893-3259-4c97-b41b-80c07937ec52.description:
Stormraider: Dealing damage equal to 25% of a champion's max Health within 2.5s applies Squall to them and grants you 25% Movement Speed for 2.5s (25s cooldown).

Squall: After 2s, deals 125 + 10% Ability Power magic damage. If the target dies before Squall triggers, it deals the same damage to nearby enemies and grants 25 gold.

94de135a-1674-48a1-bda5-85cbd1db0592.name: Banshee's Veil
94de135a-1674-48a1-bda5-85cbd1db0592.description: Annul: Grants a spell shield that blocks the next enemy ability (30s cooldown).

a4cf16f6-1f4e-48a4-9dea-85da75884780.name: Fated Ashes
a4cf16f6-1f4e-48a4-9dea-85da75884780.description:
Scorch: Damaging abilities deal 15 bonus magic damage over 3s.
Deals 45 bonus magic damage to monsters.

a79c1701-67af-4477-b653-8e9504ac3448.name: Blackfire Torch
a79c1701-67af-4477-b653-8e9504ac3448.description:
Baleful Blaze: Damaging abilities deal 20 + 2% Ability Power bonus magic damage per second for 3s. Against monsters, they deal 40 + 2% Ability Power magic damage per second.

Blackfire: For each enemy champion, epic monster and large monster affected by your Blackfire, gain 4% Ability Power.

a87e010e-8568-4cfc-b203-dbf2fa69884c.name: Crimson Lucidity
a87e010e-8568-4cfc-b203-dbf2fa69884c.description:
Summoning: Gain 20% Summoner Spell Haste.

Noxian Haste: After damaging an enemy champion with an ability, shielding or healing an allied champion, or casting a summoner spell, gain 10% (melee) / 8% (ranged) Movement Speed for 4s. The same ability can only trigger this effect once every 4s.

aa423732-7fc1-4eeb-9b72-e524a5392d0c.name: Gunmetal Greaves
aa423732-7fc1-4eeb-9b72-e524a5392d0c.description:
Blessed Blade: Basic attacks restore 12 Health on hit.

Noxian March: When your basic attacks hit champions, gain a burst of 10% (melee) / 7% (ranged) Movement Speed for 2s.

bb63a691-8760-4708-b83e-152ae93e96c9.name: Yun Tal Wildarrows
bb63a691-8760-4708-b83e-152ae93e96c9.description:
Practice Makes Perfect: Basic attacks permanently grant Crit Rate. Each attack grants 0.4% / 0.2% (melee / ranged), up to a maximum of 25%.
Flurry: Attacking an enemy champion grants 25% Attack Speed for 6s (20s cooldown). Attacks reduce this cooldown by 1s, and critical strikes increase this reduction to 2s.

c1140d29-16b8-4772-ad3a-7eb61006a85d.name: Diadem of Songs
c1140d29-16b8-4772-ad3a-7eb61006a85d.description:
Harmony: Gain 0.5% bonus Heal and Shield Power equal to max Mana and refund 25% of Mana spent.
Diadem: If you or an allied champion you healed or shielded in the last 3s are in combat, heal the nearby allied champion with the lowest Health within 800 units every second for 0.8% of your max Mana.

c634158a-8548-4e64-bc09-7cb4c2ca11f1.name: Immortal Boots
c634158a-8548-4e64-bc09-7cb4c2ca11f1.description:
Balance of Power: Gain 12 Attack Damage or 20 Ability Power.

Conversion: Gain 5% Omnivamp + 0.5% Omnivamp per takedown participation (up to 5% bonus, for a maximum of 10% Omnivamp).

Now and Forever: While above 50% Health, deal 50% bonus damage. While below 50% Health, gain 12% increased healing and shielding.

cd6aa587-8d9e-4195-b6f9-00174743e6b0.name: Hexoptics C44
cd6aa587-8d9e-4195-b6f9-00174743e6b0.description:
Magnify: Attacks deal 0% to 10% bonus damage based on the enemy's distance, reaching maximum damage at 550 units.

Arcane Precision: When a champion you damaged within the last 3s dies, gain 100 bonus attack range for 8s.

dcd347a4-5936-486a-8a89-95788e844bde.name: Chainlaced Crushers
dcd347a4-5936-486a-8a89-95788e844bde.description: Noxian Presence: Taking magic damage from champions grants a 20-140 (based on level) + 5% of your max Health magic shield (12s cooldown).

e3c3992b-f516-4eea-8668-bb548db4cc13.name: Statikk Shiv
e3c3992b-f516-4eea-8668-bb548db4cc13.description:
Energized Attacks: Moving and attacking build up an Energized attack.
Electrospark: Your Energized attack fires a chain lightning that bounces to additional targets. Bounces: 3/4/5/6, increasing at levels 1/5/9/13, dealing 60 magic damage, increased to 90 against minions and monsters. Applies on-hit effects to secondary targets.
Electroshock: Basic attacks grant 7 additional Energized stacks.

e438010b-a803-4778-a993-ce5f7981649c.name: Shurelya's Battlesong
e438010b-a803-4778-a993-ce5f7981649c.description: Inspiring Speech: Grants nearby allies 30% Movement Speed for 4s (60s cooldown).

e7b8a0b3-7f3c-4676-854f-83bef5bacd66.name: Echoes of Helia
e7b8a0b3-7f3c-4676-854f-83bef5bacd66.description: Soul Siphon: 30% of pre-mitigation damage dealt to enemy champions is stored as Soul Shards, up to a maximum of 80-250 based on level. When you heal or shield an allied champion other than yourself, all Soul Shards are consumed to heal that target for the same amount.

fb8b108f-bba1-4442-b0a8-8eb4038352a2.name: Seeker's Armguard
fb8b108f-bba1-4442-b0a8-8eb4038352a2.description: Stasis: Become invulnerable and untargetable for 2.5s, but you cannot move, attack, cast abilities or use items during this time (150s cooldown).

fcb693e4-be04-4205-a175-e64c69dd8740.name: Immortal Shieldbow
fcb693e4-be04-4205-a175-e64c69dd8740.description: Lifeline: When you take damage that would reduce your Health below 35%, gain a shield for 3s (350-650 for melee champions, 300-550 for ranged champions, based on champion level) (70s cooldown).

44e9f76c-5a0b-4446-953a-db6a1f3fdb75.name: Legend: Haste
44e9f76c-5a0b-4446-953a-db6a1f3fdb75.description: Takedowns and killing monsters and minions grant Ability Haste stacks, up to 15. Each stack grants 1.5 Ability Haste.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a83.name: Font of Life
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a83.description:
Hitting an enemy champion with an attack or ability heals you and the nearby allied champion with the lowest Health.

Ally: Restores 1.5% max Health + 5% Ability Power.

You: Restore 1% of your max Health + 5% of your Ability Power. Cooldown: 20s.

If you are a melee champion, the heal is 130% effective. (Doesn't trigger if you or nearby allies are at full Health, or if no allies are nearby.)

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a84.name: Sudden Impact
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a84.description:
After exiting stealth or using a dash, leap or teleport, your next attack or ability against an enemy champion within 4s deals 15-65 bonus true damage (10s cooldown). This effect is empowered as you level up:

Level 5: Deal 5 additional bonus true damage.

Level 9: Deal 5 additional bonus true damage and gain 10% Movement Speed for 1.5s after dealing the damage.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a85.name: Unflinching
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a85.description: Gain 3% Armor and Magic Resistance. For each nearby enemy champion, gain an additional 2% Armor and Magic Resistance. When near the maximum number of enemy champions (max 3), also gain 20% Slow Resistance.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a86.name: Electrocute
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a86.description:
Hit the same enemy champion with 3 attacks or basic abilities within 3s to deal bonus adaptive damage to them.
Damage: 60-210 + 10% bonus Attack Damage + 5% Ability Power.
Cooldown: 20-13s.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a87.name: Transcendence
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a87.description: Gain a bonus at the following levels: at level 1, gain 5 Ability Haste; at level 5, gain 5 Ability Haste; at level 9, after a basic ability hits a target, reduce that ability's cooldown by 8% (8s cooldown).

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a88.name: Perseverance
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a88.description: Gain 10% Tenacity. Gain 10-15 Armor and Magic Resistance for 1.5s after being immobilized. The duration refreshes when immobilized multiple times.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a89.name: Empowered Attack
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a89.description:
Every 8s, your next attack is empowered and deals 20-60 bonus adaptive damage to enemy champions.

80% for ranged champions.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a8a.name: Revitalize
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a8a.description: Gain 5% amplification to your heals and shields. If the target is below 40% Health, this effect is amplified by an additional 10%.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a8c.name: Last Stand
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a8c.description:
While below 60% Health, your attacks against enemy champions deal 5% to 11% bonus adaptive damage.

You deal the maximum bonus damage while below 30% Health.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a8d.name: Gathering Storm
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a8d.description:
At 6 minutes into the game, gain 2 Attack Damage or 4 Ability Power (adaptive).

Every 3 minutes, the bonus increases to 5 or 10, 9 or 18, 14 or 28, and so on.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a8e.name: Fleet Footwork
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a8e.description:
Moving, attacking and casting abilities build Energy stacks. At 100 stacks, your next attack gains Attack Speed, heals you and grants bonus Movement Speed. If you attack a champion, it also restores Mana or Energy.
Bonus Attack Speed: 40%
Health restored: 15-110 + 15% bonus Attack Damage + 10% Ability Power
Bonus Movement Speed: 20% for 1s
When attacking a champion, restores 8% of missing Mana or 8% of missing Energy
When attacking minions or monsters, heals for 35% (melee champions) or 15% (ranged champions) of the original heal amount.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a8f.name: Scorch
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a8f.description: Damaging an enemy champion with an ability scorches them, dealing 21-49 bonus magic damage (based on level) after 1s (8s cooldown).

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a90.name: Empowerment
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a90.description:
Hitting an enemy champion with 3 consecutive attacks deals bonus adaptive damage and grants 8% damage amplification until you leave combat with champions. Adaptive damage: 40-165.
Cooldown: 4s.
The damage amplification only applies against champions.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a91.name: Guardian
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a91.description:
Guard allies within 350 units and the targets of your abilities for 2.5s. If you or the guarded ally take damage above a certain threshold while guarding, both of you gain a shield for 1.5s.
Cooldown: 55-25s.
Shield: 40-165 + 6% bonus Health + 15% Ability Power.
Damage threshold: 70-240 damage taken.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a92.name: Arcane Comet
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a92.description:
Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location. When a comet hits an enemy champion, the next comet's damage is increased.
Damage: (18-95) + (3 × total hits on enemy champions) + 35% bonus Attack Damage + 20% Ability Power
Cooldown: 16-8s

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a93.name: Ice Overlord
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a93.description:
Immobilizing an enemy champion forms 3 rays around them, creating ice beneath them for 3s that slows enemies inside. The slow lingers on enemies for 1.5s after they leave the ice. You gain a protective layer of ice around you that increases your defenses. After a short delay, the ice explodes, dealing a burst of magic damage around you.
Slow: (1% of your bonus Health + 15)%
Defenses: 35 + 75% bonus Armor and Magic Resistance. Lasts 2.5s.
Magic damage: 15-100 + 5% of your bonus Health
Cooldown: 20s

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a94.name: Eyeball Collection
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a94.description: Gain 1.5 Attack Damage or 3 Ability Power for each champion or epic monster takedown. Stacks up to 8 times.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a95.name: Chain Assault
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a95.description: Damaging an enemy champion with an active ability marks them. Your next 2 attacks or active ability casts against them deal bonus adaptive damage equal to 12-38 + 3% bonus Attack Damage + 1.5% Ability Power (15s cooldown).

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a96.name: Hubris
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a96.description: Taking down an enemy champion within 3s of damaging them grants (5 + 1 per champion kill you have scored) adaptive force for 30s.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a97.name: Courage of the Colossus
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a97.description: After immobilizing an enemy champion, gain a shield that absorbs 25-45 damage + 1% max Health for 3s (18s cooldown).

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a98.name: Bone Plating
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a98.description: After taking damage from a champion, the current ability or attack and the next 3 abilities or attacks from that champion against you within 1.5s deal 30-60 less damage (40s cooldown).

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a99.name: Aery
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a99.description:
Your attacks and abilities send Aery to a target, damaging enemies or shielding allies.
Damage: 15-70 + 10% bonus Attack Damage + 5% Ability Power
Shield: 20-100 + 10% bonus Attack Damage + 5% Ability Power
Aery can't be sent out again until she returns to you.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9a.name: Tyrant
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9a.description: Damaging a champion below 50% Health deals (20-70 + 6% bonus Attack Damage + 3% Ability Power) bonus adaptive damage (10s cooldown).

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9b.name: Botanist
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9b.description:
Destroying a plant grants 10 gold and empowered plant effects. Soul Flowers near turrets grant additional bonuses.

Honeyfruit: Healing from consuming it is increased by 20%.

Scryer's Bloom: The vision granted when destroyed lasts 20% longer.

Blast Cone: After being knocked back, grants 40% Movement Speed for 2.5s.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9c.name: Axiom Arcanist
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9c.description: Your ultimate gains 10% increased damage and Heal and Shield Power (area-of-effect damage receives 5% of the increase). Taking down an enemy champion reduces your ultimate's remaining cooldown by 7%.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9d.name: Overgrowth
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9d.description: For every 3 enemy minions or 3 monsters killed near you, permanently gain 3 max Health. Max Health can increase indefinitely this way. Gain 3% bonus max Health upon reaching 30 stacks.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9e.name: Legend: Bloodline
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9e.description: Gain 1% Omnivamp. Take down monsters, enemy champions or minions to gain up to 7% bonus Omnivamp.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9f.name: Grasp of the Undying
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12a9f.description:
Every 3s in combat, your next attack against a champion is empowered.
Bonus magic damage: 3% of your Health
Heal: 1.3% of your Health
Permanent Health gain: 8
For ranged champions, these effects are reduced by 60%.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa0.name: Nimbus Cloak
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa0.description: After casting a summoner spell (Flash, Ignite, etc.), gain 10-40% bonus Movement Speed for 3s. The strength of the bonus depends on the spell's cooldown.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa1.name: Absolute Focus
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa1.description: While above 65% Health, gain 2-20 bonus Attack Damage or 4-40 bonus Ability Power (adaptive).

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa2.name: Nullifying Orb
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa2.description: If damage from a champion drops you below 35% of your max Health, gain a shield that absorbs 60-180 damage for 4s (60s cooldown).

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa3.name: Brutal
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa3.description: Your attacks deal (5 + 6% bonus Attack Damage + 3% Ability Power) bonus adaptive damage to enemy champions.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa4.name: Dark Harvest
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa4.description:
Damaging a champion below 50% Health deals adaptive damage and harvests their soul, permanently increasing Dark Harvest's damage by 10.
Dark Harvest damage: 35 + 11 per soul + 10% bonus Attack Damage + 5% Ability Power
(20s cooldown. Resets to 1s on takedowns.)

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa5.name: Phase Rush
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa5.description:
Hitting an enemy champion with basic attacks or abilities 3 times within 4s grants Movement Speed and reduces the remaining cooldown of your basic abilities by 20%.
Duration: 3s
Movement Speed: Melee: 40% to 60% | Ranged: 20% to 35%
Ability Haste: 10
Cooldown: 21 to 7s (based on level).

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa6.name: Ixtali Seedjar
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa6.description:
Destroying a plant instantly grants a seed that replaces your trinket for 60s. The seed matures and self-destructs shortly after being planted at a target location. You can also pick up seeds that appear when an ally destroys a plant.

Seeds become available 2 minutes into the game.

Each plant has an individual 30s cooldown.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa7.name: Manaflow Band
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa7.description: Hitting an enemy champion with an ability or empowered attack permanently increases your max Mana by 30, up to 300 Mana.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa8.name: Second Wind
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa8.description:
Gain 5 Health every 5s.

After taking damage from an enemy champion, regenerate 3 + 1.5% of your missing Health over the next 5s. This effect is doubled for melee champions.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa9.name: Demolish
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aa9.description: After hitting a turret with 3 basic attacks, melee champions deal 85 + 28% max Health bonus physical damage, while ranged champions deal 50 + 20% max Health bonus physical damage.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aaa.name: First Strike
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aaa.description:
If you initiate combat with an enemy champion or damage them within the first 0.25s of combat, gain 10 gold and First Strike for 3s, letting you deal 7% bonus true damage to that enemy champion. When the effect ends, gain bonus gold based on the bonus damage dealt during it.
If you don't damage the enemy champion within the first 0.25s of combat, First Strike goes on a 10s cooldown.
Bonus gold:
Melee: 60% of bonus damage
Ranged: 45% of bonus damage
Cooldown: 20-13s

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aab.name: Celerity
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aab.description: Gain 2% Movement Speed. Your bonus Movement Speed effects are also increased by 7%.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aac.name: Triumph
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aac.description: Champion takedowns restore 10% of your missing Health and 10% of your max Mana or max Energy. You also gain 35 Movement Speed for 2s.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aad.name: Legend: Alacrity
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aad.description: Gain 3% Attack Speed. Take down monsters, enemy champions or minions to gain up to 18% bonus Attack Speed.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aae.name: Lethal Tempo
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aae.description: Landing basic attacks on enemy champions grants stacking Attack Speed, 8% for melee champions and 6.4% for ranged champions, up to 6 stacks for 6s. At max stacks, attacks also fire a bolt dealing 9-30 adaptive damage for melee champions and 6-24 for ranged champions. For every 1% bonus Attack Speed, this damage increases by 1% for melee champions and 0.67% for ranged champions.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aaf.name: Conqueror
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12aaf.description:
Gain stacks of adaptive force when hitting a champion with separate attacks or abilities. Stacks up to 6 times. At max stacks, gain bonus Omnivamp.
Per stack: 3-5 bonus Attack Damage or 5-8.33 bonus Ability Power for 6s.
Max stack bonus: Melee: 9% | Ranged: 5% bonus Omnivamp.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab0.name: Battle Zeal
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab0.description: While in combat with a champion, gain 1.4% stacking damage amplification for your basic abilities every second. Stacks up to 3 times and only applies against enemy champions.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab1.name: Coup de Grace
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab1.description: Your attacks deal 8% bonus adaptive damage to enemy champions below 40% Health.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab2.name: Cheap Shot
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab2.description: Deals 10-45 bonus true damage to enemies with impaired movement (5s cooldown).

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab3.name: Hexflash
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab3.description: While Flash is on cooldown, it is replaced by Hexflash. The travel distance depends on the channel time (2s max) (18s cooldown). Goes on a 6s cooldown when entering combat with champions.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab4.name: Cut Down
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab4.description: Your attacks and abilities deal 6.5% bonus adaptive damage to enemy champions above 60% Health.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab5.name: Zombie Ward
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab5.description: Destroying an enemy ward spawns a Zombie Ward in its place that grants vision of the surrounding area for 120s. You also gain 3 Attack Damage or 6 Ability Power (max 5 stacks). You also gain stacks and create a Zombie Ward when you help destroy an enemy ward.

6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab6.name: Relentless Hunter
6a04bc5f681bf773dac12ab6.description: Gain 10 Movement Speed while out of combat. Each champion or epic monster takedown grants 2 more out-of-combat Movement Speed. The bonus stacks up to 5 times.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bca.strategic_notes: Look for extended fights where you can land the edges of your Q; without those sweet spots he loses a lot of pressure.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bd5.strategic_notes: Play around Charm: if you miss it, keep your ultimate to reposition and don't force the all-in.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bc3.strategic_notes: She needs shroud and energy to chain damage; go in after the enemy CC is used, not as a frontline initiator.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bcc.strategic_notes: Punish side lanes with the grapple and prioritize safe last hits to trigger revives in long fights.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bc7.strategic_notes: Don't spend Headbutt and Pulverize separately except to peel; his real value is initiating on key targets.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bcb.strategic_notes: Chain short dashes to dodge abilities before committing; if she goes in without charges she's very punishable.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bd1.strategic_notes: His ultimate wins games near Dragon or Baron; force fights in corridors where the enemy can't spread out.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bc6.strategic_notes: Charge your stun before moving without vision; Tibbers works both to delete carries and to zone engages.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bbe.strategic_notes: Use the hawk's vision to play pushed waves; her arrow should start picks, not just finish kills.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bb9.strategic_notes: Avoid short early trades and prioritize stacking power; in the late game he decides fights if he channels from a safe distance.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bcd.strategic_notes: Her ultimate punishes grouped teams; go in from side angles to isolate carries inside the zone.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bd6.strategic_notes: Build leads by moving before the enemy support; his portals are better for speeding up plays than for late escapes.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bce.strategic_notes: Threaten with the hook even if you don't throw it; positional pressure is worth as much as landing the ability.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bbf.strategic_notes: Wait for the enemy to group up before using your ultimate; his damage scales with bounces and lasting burns.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5ba2.strategic_notes: Stand between your marksman and the main threat; his shield loses value if you use it with your back to the enemy damage.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bd2.strategic_notes: She wins through wave control and traps under tower; if she doesn't take plates, her mid game flattens out.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bbb.strategic_notes: Play around Q2 and hookshot windows; her ultimate should isolate carries or cut escapes, not initiate on tanks.

9fefc766-01c4-45f1-8d9b-ab1cae848fcd.strategic_notes: Think more about controlling space than chasing kills. Cho'Gath wins when he forces the enemy to come to him and loses when he has to run after them.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bc4.strategic_notes: Save the package for neutral objectives; with it he can force a winning fight before it even starts.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bcf.strategic_notes: Don't chase without five stacks; when Noxian Might is active, switch targets to chain executions.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bba.strategic_notes: Mark with Q first and go in when several enemies are close; her ultimate punishes tightly grouped comps.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bc2.strategic_notes: Soak side-lane pressure and force the enemy to buy anti-heal; he doesn't need to initiate if he can wear them down with cleavers.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bc0.strategic_notes: His game revolves around cashing in his passive; avoid unnecessary deaths even when you have a damage lead.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bbd.strategic_notes: Go in with an exit route planned; his ultimate allows aggressive plays only if you don't get crowd-controlled first.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bd3.strategic_notes: Once she reaches camouflage, she changes the map's tempo: go around common vision and threaten carries without clearing waves.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bc1.strategic_notes: Keep your distance with Q before going in; Arcane Shift is your insurance, not an opening damage tool.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bc8.strategic_notes: Sweep vision before channeling your ultimate; from fog of war he turns an even fight into a full ambush.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b8f.strategic_notes: Play around vitals and save W for the key CC; in front-to-back teamfights she loses part of her identity.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b8a.strategic_notes: Use the hop to dodge the enemy's response, not just for damage; his shark starts picks from mid range.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bb6.strategic_notes: Push and answer side fights with your ultimate; his greatest value is turning skirmishes into numbers advantages.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b84.strategic_notes: Take advantage of short trades with Q and E; then back off to regenerate before pressuring again.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bac.strategic_notes: Manage rage before objectives; Mega Gnar without a nearby wall loses much of his threat.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b92.strategic_notes: His ultimate should split off carries or knock the enemy jungler away from the objective, not be thrown in just for damage.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bb2.strategic_notes: Invade when you have lane priority; his shotgun wins short duels if he fights near walls or camps.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bb7.strategic_notes: She needs time to snip with a charged Q; use the mist to deny damage before chasing.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bb3.strategic_notes: Look for long engages from outside vision; the cleaner the path, the more reliable his ultimate's fear will be.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bad.strategic_notes: Place turrets before the fight starts; setting them up late greatly reduces his zone control.

354db545-88ba-4521-ba5b-5005febd0bef.strategic_notes: Play from the second line and adapt each cast to the situation. Use his range to poke and control areas before a fight, save his crowd-control tools to stop engages or secure picks, and take advantage of immobilized targets to chain burst. He's especially strong when he can set up the terrain and cast from a safe position, but he loses a lot of value if mobile champions manage to dive straight onto him.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bae.strategic_notes: Set up low-health minions to chain Q; without passive stacks it's not worth forcing the all-in.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5baf.strategic_notes: Play reactively against engages: tornado and ultimate are worth more canceling engages than looking for weak initiations.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5ba4.strategic_notes: Gank lanes with allied CC and save your ultimate to trap targets without Flash or to cut off the jungler's routes.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b89.strategic_notes: Don't waste Counter Strike on minor damage; use it to negate the main source of basic attacks and win the extended duel.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bb4.strategic_notes: He must turn his range advantage into plates or rotations; if the enemy scales for free, his impact drops.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b8b.strategic_notes: Coordinate roots and slows to secure the fourth shot; he doesn't win long fights like a classic hypercarry.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bb5.strategic_notes: Play safe until you get a reset; with Get Excited! active she can clean up the fight from the back.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b7c.strategic_notes: Soak pressure until you find a wall; with his ultimate he can pull a carry out of their safe zone.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bc9.strategic_notes: Her abilities evolve only by completing Upgraded-tier items: the first Upgraded item lets you evolve one ability of your choice, the second lets you evolve a second one, and the third evolves the remaining ability. No specific stat thresholds are required and the evolution order is free. Go in with your ultimate only when the target is already marked and isolated.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5ba7.strategic_notes: She dominates with hops and stacked spears; her real damage shows up when she can hit without breaking her basic-attack rhythm.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b96.strategic_notes: Abuse Mantra in lane to gain priority; in fights, alternate damage and shields depending on who has the initiative.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bd4.strategic_notes: Avoid long trades before you have your ultimate; each level reduces his reliance on the lane and increases his side-lane threat.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5ba8.strategic_notes: Don't go in first: wait for crowd control to be used and daggers to be well placed so you can chain resets without getting locked down.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b86.strategic_notes: Accept losing early pressure and farm experience; once she gains range she shifts from a defensive champion to a central threat.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b8c.strategic_notes: Choose the form based on the enemy comp; go through walls to enter from angles common vision doesn't cover.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5ba5.strategic_notes: Hide the flank before your ultimate; going in head-on lets the enemy spread out and reduces the multi-stun.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5ba9.strategic_notes: Don't force against tight groups; look for isolated targets and use evolutions to adapt for hunting, poke or repositioning.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b93.strategic_notes: Plan marks with lane priority; her ultimate can save allies, but it can also deny your own executions if used late.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b97.strategic_notes: He needs constant peel and space to activate W; if he's protected, he melts tanks better than almost any other marksman.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b90.strategic_notes: Turn early priority into invades and objectives; if he doesn't speed up the game, his margin for error shrinks a lot.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5b81.strategic_notes: Punish every enemy positioning mistake; once she goes in, she needs her team to follow the chain of crowd control.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5baa.strategic_notes: Keep your speed stacks up before fighting; her ultimate is best after applying her mark to several targets.

6a07b2cd79d7ef15722f5bb8.strategic_notes: Her value lies in locking down assassins or initiating with the claw; her self-ultimate buys time for the team to arrive.
